ops.text: ARC STATUS — open by design, verdict pending a live experiment; this entry makes the closure condition explicit so the record stands alone. The gated discriminating-test tree is executing on the local machine now (lane: local-repair): TEST A reproduces the env scrub alone (env -i PATH LANG=C, sh wrapper, cwd /bin, NO setsid) against the real failing helper plist; TEST B (if A passes) reproduces setsid alone with a full environment; TEST C (if both pass) combines them. Verdict mapping: A exits 5 → root cause = proc.prepareCommand's scrubbed child environment (proc/manager.go:1143), fix = carry the user session environment (HOME/TMPDIR/USER/LOGNAME/__CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING) for launchctl children; B exits 5 → root cause = Setsid:true (manager.go:1149), fix = spawn launchctl children without session detachment; C exits 5 → both are co-factors, fix addresses both; all exit 0 → the four-attribute model is falsified and C3 (responsibility/BTM attribution of the installing process, unfixable inside daemonkit) becomes prime, to be tested via a Terminal-parented brew run. Whoever picks this up: record investigation_root_cause with the confirmed cell, land the daemonkit fix (next release after v0.20.8), then investigation_fix + confirm once a previously-failing machine converges through daemonkit's own caller. Related but SEPARATE arcs, not to be folded in: the desired-set recovery wedge (daemonkit backlog 002e2e9a, blocks yasyf-home), the quiesce exactness gate (captain-hook, surfaced 2026-07-26), and the Swift bridge EAGAIN (daemonkit 191e5724).
